source_items.scope: Explicit projective conjugacy for A positive definite, B real symmetric with simple generalized spectrum, and nonzero real step; also regular complex symmetric pencils with three distinct projective determinant roots.
Both composition factors are squares of products of four distinct independent linear forms, with constants 1/256 and 1/65536 for the specified lifts.
Eight distinct reduced base points. The source already states eight distinct points and describes a Macaulay2 check; the written proof gives explicit coordinates and reducedness.
Exactly six rank-two quadrics, each splitting into two distinct planes. The source already states the six-member count; explicit simultaneous-congruence formulas avoid a vanishing parameter chart.

source_items.scope: The twelve planes are v_i±v_j=0 and the eight points are projective sign vectors. Incidence is sigma=epsilon_i epsilon_j, giving six planes at each point and four points per plane. U sends the points to e_i and G e_i.
Euler-top factorization and projective conjugacy. Section 2 supplies a normalization-matched polynomial derivation and transports them to Nambu systems.
Six-line indeterminacy loci and degree 2n^2+1, transported by projective conjugacy.

No classification of singular pencils or nonsemisimple repeated-root pencils is asserted.

formal_scope: The pinned result declaration proves two-projectivity factorization for positive-definite real A and B, simple generalized spectrum and positive step. Auxiliary euler_top_identity proves the complex Euler cubic, and covariance proves lift covariance for a specified simultaneous congruence. The broader statements have written proofs in note.tex.
